rows.en: To think I'd end up being rescued by you again.
rows.speaker: Kahns

rows.en: Who knows what twists of fate this world has in store.
rows.speaker: Kahns

rows.en: You... Kahns!
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: I'm honored that you remember me.
rows.speaker: Kahns

rows.en: You people should be on your way to Earth right now.
We owe you for saving us. I suppose I can tell you the truth.
rows.speaker: Kahns

rows.en: Soon an unmanned refugee fleet carrying E2 in our place will plunge into Earth.
rows.speaker: Kahns

rows.en: What...! But the E2 was...
Destroyed at Jaburo, you mean?
rows.speaker: Kahns

rows.en: Do you really think he would just throw away a thing like that?
rows.speaker: Kahns

rows.en: Char Aznable, of all people?
rows.speaker: Kahns

rows.en: Char Aznable...!
There were three left... I thought they had all exploded.
So he recovered two of them...?
Exactly as you suspect.
rows.speaker: Kahns

rows.en: Earth, which has oppressed the Spacenoids for so long, at last faces its ruin.
rows.speaker: Kahns

rows.en: Char and the Spacenoids' plan to purge the Earth can no longer be stopped!
rows.speaker: Kahns

rows.en: How could you do such a thing...!
Now watch it all come to the finest of endings.
rows.speaker: Kahns
